content_blocks.steps_heading: Your Path to CAPM Certification in Kansas City

steps_items.heading: Confirm Your Eligibility
steps_items.text: CAPM requires a secondary diploma (or equivalent) and completion of project management education hours—no prior work experience needed. This makes CAPM ideal for Kansas City professionals entering project management roles across engineering, healthcare, logistics, and technology sectors.

steps_items.heading: Complete 23 Hours of Education
steps_items.text: Enroll in Granite PM Academy's live-virtual, instructor-led boot camp. Our intensive format delivers all required project management training online, allowing you to earn your credential without disrupting your current job or schedule.

steps_items.heading: Submit Your PMI Application
steps_items.text: Register with PMI and submit your CAPM application through their official portal. Pay the associated exam fee to secure your testing eligibility and activate your candidate status.

steps_items.heading: Prepare and Sit for the Exam
steps_items.text: Use Granite PM Academy's exam-preparation resources to review PMBOK® Guide content and practice test scenarios. Schedule your proctored CAPM exam and demonstrate your mastery of project management fundamentals.

steps_items.heading: Maintain Your Credential
steps_items.text: Earn professional development units (PDUs) over the three-year renewal cycle to keep your CAPM active. Continuing education keeps your skills current and positions you for advancement in Kansas City's competitive project management roles.

fq_items.question: Do I need project management experience to take the CAPM?
fq_items.answer: No prior PM experience is required. The CAPM only requires secondary education (high school diploma or equivalent) and 23 contact hours of project management education — which our course fulfills.

fq_items.question: Is the CAPM a good starting credential for {city} professionals?
fq_items.answer: Yes. The CAPM is one of the most recognized entry-level PM credentials and is highly regarded across industries in {city_state}. It demonstrates PM knowledge to employers even before you have years of experience.

fq_items.question: How does the CAPM differ from the PMP?
fq_items.answer: The PMP requires 36–60 months of project leadership experience; the CAPM does not. Many professionals earn the CAPM early in their career, gain experience, then pursue the PMP.

fq_items.question: Is this training delivered online?
fq_items.answer: Yes. Our CAPM training is fully live-virtual — no travel required. {city} students attend via video conference from wherever they are.
